run_update_failure_list_add: run the script to add new test failures from a file to the failure list
run_update_failure_list_remove: run the script to remove existing test failures from the failure list file
run_update_failure_list_add_and_remove: run the script to add and remove test failures in a single pass
review_update_failure_list: review the script that updates protobuf conformance failure lists by adding or removing test entries
summarize_update_failure_list: summarize how the script merges new failures into an existing sorted failure list file
